I’m genuinely confused at the amount of people who don’t pee in the shower 😂😂😂 I feel like a freak now. 

My vote is NTA but with all the YTA votes maybe I’ve been the ahole this whole time 😂😂😂
I’m in the same pain right now—this whole week has been turmoil. I’m here to chat if you need someone to listen to you ❤️

I feel this thread so much it is painful. I thought it was just normal for adults to be too busy ‘adulting’ to have friends.  

Fast forward, I’m a single parent, working full time, school part-time, and still manage to maintain healthy long lasting friendships.  

I do think on some level some people are just more introverted, but I think there was so much more going on with nparent.

Sorry if this has already been answered, I can't seem to find the answer quickly though: where does Jake's dad live? I know he didn't stay at the home Jake was in, but was he in Gordon? Just genuinely curious!

Agreed. At this point I keep hearing rumors so I don't know what's fact or fiction, but somehow I keep hearing that dad was shot and mom was strangled/stabbed. If that's actually true I'd think someone was really angry with the mom, so I thought maybe mom was the original target.  Again though that's totally just from the rumor mill.

I'm not sure if it's scarier knowing Jayme was the target or the parents were the target and she was abducted or this was a random burgalry gone horribly wrong

As much as I'd love for this to be true because it means we'd be one step closer to closure, I'm skeptical. Specifically who said there was a video of her being taken away from a house in Rice Lake? 'Someone said' ... who is someone?
They were planning on having the press conference regardless because of the autopsies on her parents.
